title: 第六章 江边厉鬼，深夜捡了个小灵丹
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
捂着鼻子后退几步，姜无念面前出现一大团黑影，缓缓显出人形，浑身湿漉漉的，长发拖地，满脸哀怨，不断散发出恶臭。

    那是因罪孽深重加上自身怨气而形成的祟气所发出的气味，和姜无念手里小水鬼味道截然不同。

    造孽啊，她用手在面前扇了扇，“你终于来了。”

    江面上，陆陆续续冒出许多头颅，都是在这片区域自杀的怨魂，看这样子，都听从她的调遣。

    厉鬼恶狠狠地盯着姜无念，见到她手里的灵火，便知道她和之前那些骗钱的半吊子不一样。

    她声音嘶哑，“不要碰她，她从来没有害过人，一切都是我做的。”

    双方对峙，姜无念看着眼前这密密麻麻的水鬼有些无奈，光是一个厉鬼就够收拾的了，要收拾这么多鬼，她一阵头皮发麻。

    以前，一个响指就全给它们都送走，现在她心有余而力不足。贸然出手，只会陷入危险，一切还是要求稳才行，不能冲动行事。

    指尖微松，收回了灵火，解除了小水鬼的封印，重获自由的小鬼没有立刻离开，在姜无念身边环绕了几圈，确信她并没有恶意。

    “大师，你别伤害素仪姐姐，她是……”小水鬼终于开口说了第一句话，

    但还没说完就被厉鬼打断：“回去，不关你的事。”

    它很担心，同时也很害怕，在原地挣扎许久后，终究是化作一团白光沉回水里。

    姜无念没有阻拦，淡淡扫过眼前的厉鬼，她当然知道这才是幕后老鬼，鬼气又重，执念还深。

    二十几岁的模样，看来死的时候还很年轻。

    “算了算了，我今天心情好，先放你一马。”她随意地挥了挥手，离开水边。

    厉鬼没有追赶，带着身后的众多水鬼一起缓缓下沉，江面重新归于死寂。

    姜无念刚回到值班室，正在收拾东西的林大柄立刻迎上来，一直在她耳边絮絮叨叨，像个操心的老父亲。

    “丫头，你再不回来，我都要去找你了，你这一天去哪了？这天都黑透了，江边太危险了。”

    被唠叨的心烦，但她心底莫名的浮现暖意，修行之路艰苦，身边的亲人在很早之前就已经逝去，这种被人关心的感觉她很久没有过了。

    “大叔，饿了！”
content_en:
Holding his nose and taking a few steps back, Jiang Wu Nian saw a large black shadow appear in front of him, slowly taking on a human form. The whole body was wet, the long hair was dragging to the floor, the face was filled with sadness, and a stench continued to emit.

    It was the smell of evil spirits caused by deep sins and one's own resentment. It was completely different from the smell of the little water ghost in Jiang Wu Nian's hands.

    What a sin, she fanned her face with her hands, "You are finally here."

    On the surface of the river, many heads appeared one after another, all of which were resentful souls who had committed suicide in this area. It seemed like they were all obeying her orders.

    Li Gui stared at Jiang Wu Nian fiercely, and when he saw the spirit fire in her hand, he knew that she was different from the other half-hearted people who cheated money.

    Her voice was hoarse, "Don't touch her. She has never harmed anyone. I did everything."

    The two sides were confronting each other. Jiang Wunian looked helplessly at the dense water ghosts in front of her. Just one fierce ghost was enough to deal with. She had to deal with so many ghosts, and her scalp felt numb for a while.

    In the past, she could send them all away with a snap of her fingers, but now she is more than willing to do so. If you act rashly, you will only be in danger. Everything must be stable and you cannot act impulsively.

    With his fingertips slightly loosened, he withdrew the spiritual fire and released the seal of the little water ghost. The freed little ghost did not leave immediately. He circled around Jiang Wu Nian a few times to make sure that she did not mean any harm.

    "Master, don't hurt sister Suyi, she is..." The little water ghost finally said the first sentence,

    But before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by Li Gui: "Go back, it's none of your business."

    It was worried and scared at the same time. After struggling in place for a long time, it finally turned into a ball of white light and sank back into the water.

    Jiang Wunian did not stop him, and simply scanned the ghost in front of her. Of course she knew that this was the old ghost behind the scenes, with a strong aura and deep obsession.

    He looked in his twenties, and he seemed to have been very young when he died.

    "Forget it, I'm in a good mood today, so I'll let you go first." She waved her hand casually and left the water.

    The Li Gui did not pursue him, but slowly sank with him along with the many water ghosts behind him, and the river surface returned to deathly silence.

    As soon as Jiang Wunian returned to the duty room, Lin Daying, who was packing her things, immediately came up to her and kept nagging in her ear, like a worried old father.

    "Girl, if you don't come back, I'm going to look for you. Where have you been all day? It's completely dark today. The riverside is too dangerous."

    She was annoyed by being nagged, but there was an inexplicable warmth in her heart. The path of cultivation was difficult, and the relatives around her had passed away a long time ago. She had not experienced this feeling of being cared about for a long time.

    "Uncle, I'm hungry!"
title_en: Chapter 6: The devil by the river picked up a small elixir late at night
